name: Pin9
direction: The Peacock of Small Universes — C
selectedOption: C (right), the peacock with nine circular tail windows
originalLocation: Untouched board and lossless C panel preserved in dali-nine-disks-C-originals.zip supplied in chat. Repository retains the full-dimension compressed panel, including the reflection.
processing: Extract the complete artwork-only right panel at (973,116), 462 x 847, removing board labels, gutter and frame. Encode AVIF at those original crop dimensions without resizing, repainting or recolouring. The existing face-fit helper shows a 3:4 window with zero stretch and zero bleed, retaining all nine tail disks and the bird; most of the reflected bird is outside the playable crop but preserved in the source. Image placement rounds to hundredths of a layout unit.
approval: Carl selected the peacock after reviewing three Dali nine-disks concepts and explicitly requested GitHub deployment. The carpet and orchard alternatives are not selected.
